for: the Drama Slam's battle stage props

set_road.desc: act 1: a country road between green hills, under a blue sky; pivot at the bottom middle, on the stage floor at the back

set_ballroom.desc: act 2: a painted ballroom, gold walls, red drapes across starry windows, a checkered floor, from the style model; pivot at the bottom middle

set_volcano.desc: act 3: a painted volcano on a sunset sky over lava, from the style model; the flame card rises out of its crater at 238, 75

cardboard_sun.desc: act 1's cardboard sun on a stick, smiling, from the style model; a stagehand raises it behind the hills; pivot at the stick's foot

volcano_flame_0.desc: the eruption's flame card, frame 0: it rises out of the crater (slide it up from behind the cone) and flickers between the two frames

volcano_flame_1.desc: the eruption's flame card, frame 1: it rises out of the crater (slide it up from behind the cone) and flickers between the two frames
